note: In Phys. VIII lect. 9 n. 1041: what a mover uses as an instrument cannot cause motion without a principal mover moving it, as a stick without the hand. Closer than SCG I.13 [15] (the instrument is moved by the principal), but it speaks of what is used as an instrument, not of every mover that does not move by its own form, and does not type the per se link.
